select content, metadata->'metadata'->>'type' as type
from documents
where metadata->'metadata'->>'lead_id' = '{{ $json.body.lead_id }}'
order by 
  case metadata->'metadata'->>'type'
    when 'summary' then 1
    when 'basic_info' then 2
    else 3
  end;

select role, content 
from conversations
where session_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.session_id }}'
order by created_at asc;
